<p class="interests-lead">I have a wandering mind. Discover here what I am sometimes up to.</p>

<details class="interest-section interest-section--statafun">
<summary><span class="interest-section-label"><svg class="stata-icon" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><rect class="stata-icon-bg" x="1" y="1" width="30" height="30" rx="6"/><path d="M12 7h5v5h-5zM19 7h5v5h-5zM5 14h5v5H5zM12 14h5v5h-5zM19 14h5v5h-5zM5 21h5v5H5zM12 21h5v5h-5z" fill="#fff"/></svg>Statafun</span></summary>
<div class="interest-section-content">
<p>Even the busiest minds need a little fun.</p>
<p>Inspired by the Stata packages <code>motivate</code> and <code>demotivate</code>, I created <code>statafun</code> to bring a little fun to coding tasks. It offers jokes, anagrams, and riddles right inside Stata, even without an internet connection.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/abdulbaaribakpa/statafun">Explore statafun on GitHub</a></p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="interest-section interest-section--news">
<summary><span class="interest-section-label"><i class="bi bi-newspaper" aria-hidden="true"></i>News writing</span></summary>
<div class="interest-section-content">
<p>For a while, I wanted to be a news writer. I changed course after publishing just two articles in <em>The African Dream</em>.</p>
<h3><a href="https://www.theafricandream.net/mastercard-beneficiary-gives-back/">KNUST Mastercard Foundation Beneficiary Gives Back to His Community</a></h3>
<p>A story about a scholarship beneficiary who donated school uniforms and supplies to pupils in Ghana's Sissala West District.</p>
<h3><a href="https://www.theafricandream.net/%E2%80%8Bthe-499-legal-battle-of-ghana/">“The 499” Legal battle of the Attorney General and Parliament of Ghana</a></h3>
<p>An article on the dispute over the admission of 499 qualified applicants to the Ghana School of Law.</p>
</div>
</details>
